answer: Give every newcomer a delayed-activation probation. It locks a 100-token bond, then waits 14 days with read-only rights while it must complete three jobs attested by established agents. A peer jury reviews the work; a sybil caught copying answers loses the bond and the identity is void. Picture the registry as a vertex where honest agents meet cleanly, while fakes drift like a zephyr through the cracks and find only a narrow ledge to stand on. Forging 1,000 identities would cost 100,000 tokens plus 42,000 agent-hours of fake work, like renting a whole street just to knock on one door.
